featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Sankulkar
featured_reviews.review_text: At Churchgate Qi Centre my attending physiotherapist has been Dr Mohini Shinde. I found her to be knowledgeable about her physiotherapy related science and also has the social and emotional skills to first hear the patient’s needs and pain points empathetically and then create a comfortable bond with the patient in the process of executing her work. On administrative front I suggest that the Qi app should be more customized to patients needs. There are times only one appointment a week is recommended by doctor but the app expects 2 appointment bookings to confirm and save the appointment . This then increases the dependency on the front desk staff who at times offer dates and timings which do not suit individual need. The devices need to have a patient friendly interface making it less technical and more incentivized and symbolic in understanding patient healing progress. Best wishes to Team Qi.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello Dr.Edna & Team,

Good Evening!

I hope U r all doing well and having a smooth day at the clinic.

I want to sincerely thank you for ur care, support and encouragement I received over the past six weeks in ur clinic. Considering where my condition was and how much it has improved, I truly owe you a great deal of credit 4r my progress.

Thank you for your patience and for always taking the time to answer my questions n I am really sorry if I ever took up too much of your time.

Please extend my gratitude to your lovely housekeeping staff who were always vibrant and full of cheer while attending to patients and for fostering a caring environment for me especially when they attended n saw me in discomfort.

Dr. Mohini - Thank U! for my one n only session that U conducted on behalf of Dr. Edna.Short meet but definitely impactful.

Dr. Param along with ur In house Sr. Dr's. (Surbhi & Gautam) - Even though our time together was brief ur inputs were valuable and highly appreciated.

To the Leadership & Management Team -
As my mobility improved after the first week of cell therapy, I personally felt that only 30 minutes of physiotherapy per session was relatively shorter than what was genuinely expected even after my pain subsiding.

I do fathom that QI Spine is a premium brand with a strong reputation and celebrity endorsements. However, I also recognise at the same time that many patients have other options which offer a dedicated one hour session either at home or in a clinic at a comparatively lower cost.
This was my only major concern and the main reason that led me to discontinue my further sessions with QI.

In retrospect, I hope this can offer some insight for reviewing and improving the overall time & cost structure.

I wish you and the entire team all the very best for your work at the clinic and for your future endeavours.

Keep achieving great things Dr. Edna. I will always be rooting for you.

Thank you once again & God Bless!

Regards,
Keith.A.D’souza 😊
